positions.name: SpokenDecisionToRecord
positions.frame: how does the spoken decision-and-rationale get carried into the written summary record?
positions.why: src-1/src-2/src-3 are Quinton's spoken declarative, assertive, and commissive acts announcing the Zypherion adoption, its performance rationale, and its timeline; src-4/src-5/src-6 restate the same three facts as bold-label summary lines under an explicit footing (animator/author Xena, principal Quinton). The directional reads track in lockstep across the pair-sets — decision/claim/decision in conviction, authority-ranking/market-pricing/authority-ranking in relational, present-realis/present-realis/future-irrealis in temporal — showing the written lines are a re-issuing of the same three spoken moves rather than a new stance. The tension the set holds: src-2 and src-5 read as movable, evidence-backed claims while src-1/3 and src-4/6 read as ratified decisions, yet both registers are carried by the same principal across the spoken-to-written translation.
